conventions.evidence: app/Actions/IssueTicket.php: `class IssueTicket` with `__invoke` (domain write via app/Actions); database/migrations/2026_10_29_042907_create_queues_table.php and 2026_10_29_042908_create_tickets_table.php both have reversible `down()` with `dropIfExists`; app/Models/Queue.php `#[Fillable(['entity_id','name','slug','is_active','labels_i18n'])]` and Ticket `#[Fillable([...])]` set deliberately; docs/business-rules.md + docs/database-schema.md + CHANGELOG.md updated in same change; no Livewire/Blade/Bulma surface in scope

readability.evidence: app/Models/Ticket.php: `private const MUTABLE`, `nextCode()` with docblock explaining insertion-order + skipped legacy codes, `call(User $user): void` small and focused; app/Actions/IssueTicket.php: `MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5` with stale-queue comment; consistent naming, no dead code or debug output

requirements.evidence: app/Actions/IssueTicket.php: `__invoke(Queue $queue, int $priority = 0, TicketChannel $channel = TicketChannel::Virtual): Ticket` with `priority < 0` InvalidArgumentException, `lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail()` + `InactiveQueueException`, `Ticket::nextCode()` and retry on `UniqueConstraintViolationException`; app/Models/Ticket.php: `nextCode()` `/^A(\d+)$/` via `lazyByIdDesc` (A001, A1000 growth, insertion order, skips A-X, no reuse after delete), write-once `updating` guard throwing LogicException except status/called_at/called_by_user_id/updated_at, `call()` with membership check + DB-locked status check; migrations have unique (queue_id,code), unique (entity_id,slug), index (queue_id,status,priority,issued_at), cascades/nullOnDelete; Queue/Ticket/Entity/Enums/Exception/factories (forQueue, sequential A001/A002, explicit code kept) all match contract

scope.evidence: change.diff: only queues/tickets migrations, Queue/Ticket models, TicketStatus/TicketChannel enums, InactiveQueueException, IssueTicket action, Queue/Ticket factories, Entity::queues(), docs/business-rules.md + docs/database-schema.md + CHANGELOG Unreleased entry, and Queue/IssueTicket/TicketModel tests; no unrelated refactors or features

security.evidence: app/Models/Ticket.php: `call()` throws `AuthorizationException` for non-members before any write (ticket unchanged) and `LogicException` for non-waiting via `lockForUpdate()->value('status')`; app/Actions/IssueTicket.php validates priority server-side and re-reads `is_active` under lock; Ticket::create uses fixed server fields with explicit fillable, call() uses forceFill of server-generated call fields only; write-once guard blocks illicit field changes; no Livewire surface, no unescaped output, no secrets

simplicity.evidence: app/Actions/IssueTicket.php (~56 lines): single transaction + retry loop, no service/repository layers; app/Models/Ticket.php: `nextCode()` loop with regex, no speculative abstractions; factories reuse Entity/Queue factories with minimal `forQueue` state and per-ticket `store()` for sequencing

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Queue/IssueTicketTest.php (7 tests): defaults A001/waiting/virtual, sequential codes with priority/channel, negative priority persists nothing, inactive + stale-deactivated rejection persists nothing, collision retry to A002, give-up after repeated collisions; tests/Feature/Queue/TicketModelTest.php: factory defaults/casts, forQueue A001/A002 + explicit A-X, count(3) distinct codes, unique-per-queue, nextCode empty/A999-A1001/insertion-order/deleted-middle/malformed/scoped, write-once matrix, call-once/stale/non-member-unchanged/cascade-nulls/enums

review.summary: Adds queues/tickets persistence and ticket issuance/calling per contract, with correct per-queue A001 sequencing, stale-queue rejection, collision retry, write-once and single-call guards. Change follows project conventions, is secure and minimal, ships comprehensive Pest tests and synced docs, with no scope creep.
